Inscriptions v1.0-inscribe

Artifacts become effects written on a card. A mark on the card shows it in the Chain. Three marks to choose from, shown on a Common, a Rare and a Legendary card, in the Chain row and in the deck tile. Every frame is 915 × 412, the Pixel 10 in landscape. Rules and the full inventory: docs/inscriptions.md.
